The rules for offering Arghya, doing Pooja etc. to them are in the Shastras, there is no fault, for Samyag Drishti
there is no fault, there is provision. Rather, the question arises
that Vrati, second Pratima dhari, third Pratima
dhari, seventh Pratima dhari etc., how will they do Aaradhana of these Avrati, their Arghya
? This question comes to me every other day.
There is only one answer that Acharya Poojyapada Swami etc. big Acharyas, Abhayanandi,
Gunasuri etc. all these were Mahavratis and they
have specified Pooja rules for Shravakas, for Deshavratis.
So in that they have ordered to offer Arghya, without their Aaradhana, without their Arghya
Pooja is not completed at all, in Pooja vidhi and at the end, in beginning, at the end, Arghyas definitely
come, of Dikpala etc., of Kshetrapala etc.
So Acharya is authority for us, they too must know the arrangement of Gunasthanas.
We should not raise any logic in this. For us, the order of Acharya is to be honored, on head
and forehead. In the tradition of Acharya Shantisagara Maharaja Ji,
Padmavati etc. Shasana Devata
have been acknowledged, offering Arghya to Kshetrapala, Dikpala etc. has been recognized, Panchamruta
